request: Create and select Suey based on Ian's original GitHub project, including her bag of tricks; preserve an editable first iteration.

observed.sprite_walker.py: Transparent always-on-top PyQt girl sprite. Randomly chooses walk1, walk2 or sit every 3 seconds; GIF assets referenced but not committed. Logs wandering whispers.
observed.main.py: Watcher prototype repeatedly returns a simulated keylogger_spike event, invokes decoy, reaction and Telegram hooks.
observed.decoy_injection.py: Logs deliberately fake credentials as decoys.
observed.honeypot_monitor.py: Polls directory membership and logs new entries; does not actually detect reads of existing files.
observed.deprecated/watcher_core.py: Legacy clipboard polling and keypress logging plus poetic-payload helper.
observed.cryptic_payloads.txt: Three short poems about static, watchers, encrypted verse and intent.

inferred_art_direction: SUPERSEDED by user-supplied character references: blank expression at all times, straightened black hair and blunt bangs, white headband, straight Alice-like black dress and ivory apron, no cape. Black hip trick pouch, silver key, ivory scroll. Expressions must never change; states are communicated only by body motion.
capability_boundary: The Work pet is animated artwork and native state reactions. Repository watcher, clipboard, keyboard, honeypot and Telegram code is not executed or installed.
library_status: No ChatGPT Library tools exposed. Local Pets/Suey folder preserves source and QA artifacts; do not claim Library upload.
